notes: Pinned installed 2c-highground/game.map is byte-identical after an unchanged complete-source write.
Typed tile and existing-gateway changes preserve every untouched and trailing byte.

limitations: The bounded slice reads exact game.map terrain tiles and gateways plus version 1/2 droid.json, struct.json and feature.json object placement.
Official wzmaplib ignores the authored third position component for these objects; Modkit preserves exact x/y and uint16-turn rotation while naming elevation and footprints unavailable.

When a resolved data catalog is supplied, placed objects expose portable catalog-proved logical PIE model references; archive-path resolution, PIE texture directives, runtime model selection and runtime material semantics remain named unavailable facets.
Scroll limits, scenario scripts, terrain materials, water and navigation remain named unavailable facets.

The writer changes tile texture/height values and existing gateway coordinates only; resize, version conversion, gateway insertion/deletion, container packing and other map documents remain unsupported.
The writer returns fresh validated replacement bytes and requests no filesystem permission; host write-source authorization and atomic commit remain outside this provider.
Container extraction, rendering, launch and packing remain outside this provider.
The world scene surface is publisher-qualified candidate org.modkitx.opensource.warzone2100/world-scene-source@1, not an admitted common.view contract.
